obligations.text: The optimized rustev_wasm_bg.wasm is at most 2,621,440 bytes uncompressed and at most 786,432 bytes under gzip level 9, measured in CI as spec 027 3.10.6 defines; exceeding either fails the bindings job.

sectionHeadings: 046: The WebAssembly module's uncompressed size budget (amends 027)
record.summary: A narrow amendment of approved spec 027 3.10.4. The uncompressed size budget of the optimized `rustev_wasm_bg.wasm` was declared at 2,097,152 bytes before specs 032 and 033 added their document types; the first measurement is 2,215,589 bytes, 5.6% over, while the gzip and instantiation budgets hold. This spec raises the uncompressed budget to 2,621,440 bytes (2.5 MiB) and keeps every other budget, the procedure and the gate unchanged. Ratified by the owner on 2026-10-20 (A-43).
record.title: The WebAssembly module's uncompressed size budget (amends 027)
